user.title: Connect to aw-server
user.description: Enter the address of the aw-server instance to read from. Note that aw-server has no authentication: only connect to servers on a network you trust.

hosts.title: Select hosts to track
hosts.description: Each selected host becomes a device with activity sensors. Hosts with recent activity are preselected.

error.missing_device_id: The server did not report a device ID. Is this an aw-server (v0.12 or newer)?

abort.no_hosts: No tracked hosts were found on this aw-server

error.no_hosts_selected: Select at least one host to track
